title: bug: VS Code runs vm-control with the full extension-host env, while JetBrains scrubs it under the protected profile
description:
Found in the CQ-I06f whole-epic review at 96f7bdd4 (I05 residual). JetBrains ManagedVmPanel.execute applies supervisor.protectedDaemonEnvironment(builder.environment()) when RuntimeSelectionPolicy.profile is PROTECTED (ManagedVmPanel.kt:117-122). VS Code ManagedVmTreeProvider.execute (:75-80) calls runVmControl(execFile, ...), whose options (ManagedVm.ts:96) carry no env. The child therefore inherits every extension-host variable, including MOE_RUNNER_STATE_DIR, which picks the VM ledger dir (vm-control.mjs ownedLedgerDir).
This is latent while verified-local is unavailable (the daemon refuses with EXECUTION_PROFILE_NOT_READY). It must be at parity before strong-profile activation.
definitionOfDone: Under a protected (verified-local) read, VS Code runs vm-control with the same scrubbed environment JetBrains uses; legacy/observe stays unchanged.
A moe-vscode node:test pins the env passed to execFile for both profiles.
cd moe-vscode && npm test passes in a snapshot.
